title: UiPath first-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results
excerpt: Revenue grew 17% to $418 million, ARR grew 12% to $1.901 billion, dollar-based net retention was 109%, and full-year revenue guidance was $1.776-$1.781 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supports current ARR, revenue, retention, gross margin, operating income, cash flow, liquidity, and second-quarter and full-year fiscal 2027 guidance.
